He died April 9, 1999, in Cleveland, Ohio.  Wallace was buried at the Lakeview Cemetery there.  He served two years in the U.S. Army and was discharged as a private first class.
Myrtle Hill Memorial Park | Myrtle Hill Memorial Park is a cemetery in Tampa, Florida established in 1917.  Ildebrando Zacchini, Doyle E. Carlton, Dennis Hoey, and Wallace O. Stovall, Sr. are buried at the cemetery.  The cemetery is located at 4207 East Lake Avenue.
Harvey Milk (opera) | Harvey Milk is an opera in three acts composed by Stewart Wallace to a libretto by Michael Korie.  A joint commission by Houston Grand Opera, New York City Opera, and San Francisco Opera, it was premiered on January 21, 1995 by Houston Grand Opera.  The opera is based on the life and death of the gay activist and politician Harvey Milk who was assassinated along with San Francisco's mayor George Moscone on November 27, 1978.
